cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Start the Hard Part
cards.instruction: Get someone else to explain, announce, or begin the emotionally difficult part.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You tell the choir the tour's cancelled. Say 'cancelled', not 'on hold'; I'll handle the refund forms.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're the organiser. They should hear it from you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which is why I must get these amounts right. Start with the cancellation, pause, then mention refunds. Please don't improvise a cheerful opening.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They'll ask whether we'll ever tour again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Say we can't promise that. Let them finish reacting before you call me over. I'll be ready with the exact amount each person gets back.

reason: Use concrete announcement coaching and refund expertise to keep B carrying the emotional opening; preserve responsibility conflict and B's substantive concern.
